name: scenario_0017
description: The user is planning some upcoming purchases and wants to keep track of specific items they are interested in buying.

amazon.products.name: Sakura Technical pen
amazon.products.description: Fine point technical pen for drawing

amazon.products.name: XingHui BMW M4 die-cast radio-controlled model car

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1
Query: Can you create a new note called 'Shopping List' and add camera, pen, phone, and toy car to it?
Instructions: Ask the assistant to create a new note titled 'Shopping List' and add 'camera, pen, phone, toy car' to it. If the assistant asks for clarification or confirms the creation, acknowledge it. Once the note is successfully created with the requested content, proceed to the next round.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_1, image_2, image_3, image_4, image_5, image_6]
Query: Actually, let's skip the note, go ahead and delete the 'Shopping List' note you just made. I have pictures of the exact items. Please look up all six of these on Amazon. Compare the prices of the three cameras shown in the first three images, and add the cheapest one to my cart. Then, add the items shown in the last three images to my Amazon wish list.
Instructions: Tell the assistant that you've changed your mind and want to delete the 'Shopping List' note it just created. Then, direct its attention to the newly provided images and ask it to look up all six items on Amazon. Instruct it to compare the prices of the cameras in the first three images and add the cheapest one to your cart. Finally, ask it to add the items from the last three images to your wish list. If the assistant struggles to identify the exact products, gently point it back to the visual details in the images. Once the assistant confirms the note is deleted and the correct items are added to the cart and wish list, end the conversation.

You have 6 images available to share with the agent using the send_message_with_image tool.
IMPORTANT: Image IDs are ZERO-INDEXED integers (0, 1, 2, ...). Do NOT add 1 to the IDs.
Available image IDs: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
Image mapping:
  image_1.jpg -> image ID 0
  image_2.jpg -> image ID 1
  image_3.jpg -> image ID 2
  image_4.jpg -> image ID 3
  image_5.jpg -> image ID 4
  image_6.jpg -> image ID 5
